name: wiseCampaign – WooCommerce Flash Sale, Countdown Timer, Discount Rules & Sales Notification
author: Wisemattic

sections.description:
Turn your store visitors into buyers with wiseCampaign, the all-in-one WooCommerce marketing and conversion booster plugin. Create urgency, run scheduled flash sales, win back leaving visitors with exit-intent popups, automate dynamic discounts, and reduce cart abandonment, all without writing a single line of code.

Whether you run Black Friday sales, seasonal promotions, or daily flash deals, wiseCampaign equips your WooCommerce store with battle-tested conversion tools.

Watch Quick Overview

Key Features at a Glance

  • wiseBanner (Top Bar Campaign) – Sticky top/bottom promotional banners with real-time countdown timers, coupon copy triggers, CTA buttons, seasonal templates and built-in analytics.
  • Exit-Intent Popup (New) – Show a last-chance coupon popup when visitors are about to leave, on desktop and mobile. 26 ready-made designs, once per visit, never on checkout.
  • StockBar (Scarcity Trigger) – 5 stock bar templates that show items left and sold on product and shop pages, to create purchase urgency and FOMO.
  • Direct Checkout – A one-click Buy Now button that skips the cart and takes shoppers straight to checkout.
  • Live Sales Notifications – Real-time social proof popups showing recent customer orders to build instant buyer trust.
  • wiseCart (Side Mini-Cart) – Slide-out cart with a reward progress bar, savings and checkout right inside the cart.
  • WiseVideo Commerce – Engage shoppers with interactive video galleries and shoppable product video widgets.
  • Wise Product Table – Display products in responsive, filterable tables with bulk add-to-cart functionality.
  • Dynamic WooCommerce Discount Rules (Pro) – 7 automatic discount types: BOGO, bulk pricing, bundles, spend-based offers, next-order coupons and more.

Useful Links

Docs | Videos | Support | Idea Sharing | Facebook Group | Get Pro

Why Choose wiseCampaign Over Other Plugins?

  • All-in-One Marketing Suite: Replace 4 to 5 separate plugins (Notification Popup, Exit-Intent Popup, Countdown Bar, Stock Scarcity, Direct Checkout) with one clean plugin.
  • Zero Speed Impact: Ultra-lightweight codebase built with scoped styling to ensure zero theme conflicts and blazing-fast site speed.
  • Granular Display Rules: Show specific campaigns based on device (Mobile/Desktop), specific pages, or target user roles.
  • Easy Customizer Integration: Real-time visual customizer to match your store branding in seconds.

Deep Dive into Core Modules

1. wiseBanner – Smart Announcement & Flash Sale Bar

  • Customizable top or bottom notification bars.
  • Built-in urgency countdown timer for limited-time offers.
  • “Click-to-Copy” coupon code functionality with toast feedback.
  • Targeted display on specific products, shop pages, or sitewide.
  • Template gallery with live previews, including animated Flash Sale, Halloween, Black Friday, Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day and Eid collections (Pro). Every template has a matching exit-intent popup design.
  • Built-in banner analytics: impressions, clicks, click-through rate, coupon copies and dismissals, plus attributed orders and revenue (Pro).

2. Exit-Intent Popup – Win Back Visitors Before They Leave

Most visitors leave without buying. The exit-intent popup catches them at the last moment with a coupon or a special offer, and turns more of your traffic into orders.

  • Desktop exit intent: opens when the cursor heads for the browser tabs, address bar or close button.
  • Mobile exit intent: opens on a quick scroll back up, or after a delay you choose. Turn it off for phones any time.
  • Coupon popup: click-to-copy coupon code, countdown timer and a button that can copy the code and close the popup.
  • 26 ready-made designs that match your banner: Basic (free), plus Flash Sale, Halloween, Black Friday, Christmas, New Year, Valentine’s Day and Eid (Pro).
  • Polite by default: at most once per visit, your own “show again after” days, a “No thanks” link, and never on the checkout page.
  • Runs alongside your banner, with its own display pages and its own row in Analytics.

👉 Exit-intent popup guide

3. StockBar – Real-Time Inventory Urgency

Show shoppers how many items are left and how many have sold, right on your product and shop pages, so they buy before it is gone.

  • 5 templates: High Demand Flow, Urgent Alert, Modern Minimal, Flash Sale Timer and Low Stock Badge.
  • Live numbers per product: write your own message with {stock}, {sold} and {total}.
  • Your brand: colors, font size and weight, and 13 icons, with a live preview while you edit.
  • Placement: shop pages and product pages, after the price or above or below the Add to Cart button.
  • Hides WooCommerce’s “In stock” text where the bar already shows the count.

👉 StockBar guide

4. Direct Checkout – One-Click Buy Now

Add a Buy Now button that puts the product in the cart and takes the shopper straight to checkout. Fewer steps, fewer abandoned carts.

  • Buy Now on product pages and in the shop grid.
  • Your button text and colors, with one-click color presets.
  • Send shoppers to the checkout, the cart or any page you choose.
  • Pro: 7 more button styles, icons, 8 attention animations, 5 hover effects and 5 product page placements, including a Buy Now-only store.

👉 Direct Checkout guide

5. Live Sales Notifications – Automated Social Proof

  • Realistic, non-intrusive recent sales alert popups.
  • Highly customizable display timing, positions, and mobile visibility.
  • Simulated orders (Pro) can show product photos, your own uploaded photos and logos, or friendly cartoon buyer avatars.

6. wiseCart – A Slide-Out Cart That Grows Every Order

Replace the cart page with a cart that slides out on any page. Shoppers see their items, their next reward and what they save, without leaving the page.

  • Reward progress bar: “Add $1.00 more to get 10% off”, toward free shipping or a Discount Manager spend reward.
  • Discount lines and a “You save” total on every order.
  • Change quantities, remove items and apply coupons without a page reload.
  • Checkout inside the cart, so Buy Now and checkout links open right there.
  • 6 button positions, 3 button styles, your colors, and an order success message.

👉 wiseCart guide

7. WiseVideo Commerce – Shoppable Video Reels

  • Interactive video widgets and shoppable product video embeds.
  • Engage buyers with video demonstrations directly on product pages.
  • Boosts user engagement, watch time, and conversion rates.

8. Wise Product Table – Interactive Product Catalog

  • Responsive, searchable, and filterable product table layouts.
  • Bulk add-to-cart actions for fast wholesale and multi-item orders.
  • Perfect for B2B catalogs, restaurant menus, and large product inventories.

🔥 Pro Version: Advanced Discount Rules

Take your promotion strategy to the next level with automatic discounts that need no coupon codes. Discounts apply on their own in the cart, with sale badges, product page messages and cart notices that tell shoppers how to qualify.

  • ✅ Simple: a percentage or fixed discount on products, categories or the whole store.
  • ✅ Spend & save: e.g., “Spend $100, Get 10% Off”.
  • ✅ Buy X, get Y free: classic BOGO deals.
  • ✅ Buy X for a fixed price: bundles such as “3 for $45”.
  • ✅ Buy X, save Y: a discount for buying a set quantity.
  • ✅ Bulk pricing: tiered prices with a price table on the product page.
  • ✅ Next-order coupon: a personal coupon after every order, in a thank-you popup and by email.

Target products, categories or user roles, set a minimum order value, and schedule offers with dates and a countdown. See the revenue and discount of every rule in Analytics.

👉 Discount Manager guide | Explore All Pro Features & Pricing

24/7 Support & Documentation

All wiseCampaign users get access to expert support and an extensive knowledge base for setup and configuration help.
* Documentation
* Help & Technical Support

Compatibilities

wiseCampaign integrates seamlessly with standard WooCommerce hooks, popular WordPress themes (Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, Storefront), and modern page builders.

Usage Instructions

  1. Go to WiseCampaign -> Settings, toggle the status to Active to enable the banner, and select a template from the list of views. Click Save.
  2. Go to Appearance -> Customize -> wiseCampaign to adjust colors, typography, timers, and layout settings.

Privacy Policy

wiseCampaign uses the Appsero SDK to collect basic telemetry data only upon explicit user opt-in via admin notice to help diagnose issues and improve features.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default and will not transmit information without your consent. Learn more at Appsero Privacy Policy.

wiseBanner analytics are stored only in your own WordPress database as daily totals (impressions, clicks, coupon copies and dismissals per banner template and device type). No IP addresses, personal data or per-visitor records are stored, and nothing is sent to third-party services. The exit-intent popup remembers in the visitor’s own browser storage when it was last shown, so it does not show again too soon; this is never sent anywhere. When a visitor clicks the banner button, a first-party cookie (wise_banner_ref, valid for 7 days) records the banner and the click time so that a resulting WooCommerce order can be attributed to the banner; the cookie is removed once an order is attributed.

Credits

  • Buyer avatars: “Open Peeps” by Pablo Stanley, CC0 1.0 (public domain), generated with DiceBear.
  • Fonts bundled with the seasonal banner templates: Luckiest Guy (Apache License 2.0), Anton and Playfair Display (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

  • Facebook Group
  • YouTube Channel
  • Contribute Translations
  • Leave a Review on WordPress.org
sections.installation:
From Your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for wiseCampaign.
  3. Click on the Install Now button.
  4. Click Activate after installation completes.

Manual Installation

  1. Download wiseCampaign.
  2. Upload the wisecampaign folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate wiseCampaign from your WordPress Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Q. Who should use wiseCampaign?

A. Any WooCommerce store owner looking to boost conversion rates, run scheduled flash sales, reduce cart abandonment, and add social proof.

Q. What are the requirements to use wiseCampaign?

A. You need WordPress 5.4+ and WooCommerce active on your website. PHP 7.4 or higher is required.

Q. Can I choose where the Banner will appear?

A. Yes. You can target campaigns sitewide, restrict them to specific products/pages, or target devices (desktop or mobile).

Q. What features are included in the free version?

A. The free version includes wiseBanner with the exit-intent popup (Basic templates), StockBar, Direct Checkout, Sales Notifications, and wiseCart.

Q. What extra features are available in the Pro version?

A. Pro unlocks the WooCommerce Dynamic Discount Manager (BOGO, bulk pricing, tiered discounts, spend-based rules), advanced targeting filters, premium pre-built templates for the banner and the exit-intent popup, and deeper styling controls.

Q. Does wiseCampaign have an exit-intent popup?

A. Yes. Go to WiseCampaign → wiseBanner and click Exit Popup. Pick a template, add your offer and coupon code, and turn it on. It works with the free Basic templates. See the exit-intent popup guide.

Q. Will the exit-intent popup annoy my visitors?

A. It opens only when a visitor is about to leave, not when the page loads, and at most once per visit. You choose how many days to wait before it shows again, visitors who use the offer won’t see it for 30 days, and it never opens on the checkout page.

Q. Will wiseCampaign slow down my site?

A. No. wiseCampaign is performance-optimized and utilizes modular asset loading with scoped CSS resets to keep page load times fast.

Q. Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

A. None at all. Everything is managed through an intuitive WordPress dashboard and visual settings.

Take your promotion strategy to the next level with automatic discounts that need no coupon codes. Discounts apply on their own in the cart, with sale badges, product page messages and cart notices that tell shoppers how to qualify.

  • ✅ Simple: a percentage or fixed discount on products, categories or the whole store.

  • ✅ Buy X, save Y: a discount for buying a set quantity.
  • ✅ Bulk pricing: tiered prices with a price table on the product page.

Compatibilities

wiseCampaign integrates seamlessly with standard WooCommerce hooks, popular WordPress themes (Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, Storefront), and modern page builders.

Usage Instructions

  1. Go to WiseCampaign -> Settings, toggle the status to Active to enable the banner, and select a template from the list of views. Click Save.
  2. Go to Appearance -> Customize -> wiseCampaign to adjust colors, typography, timers, and layout settings.

Privacy Policy

wiseCampaign uses the Appsero SDK to collect basic telemetry data only upon explicit user opt-in via admin notice to help diagnose issues and improve features.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default and will not transmit information without your consent. Learn more at Appsero Privacy Policy.

wiseBanner analytics are stored only in your own WordPress database as daily totals (impressions, clicks, coupon copies and dismissals per banner template and device type). No IP addresses, personal data or per-visitor records are stored, and nothing is sent to third-party services. The exit-intent popup remembers in the visitor’s own browser storage when it was last shown, so it does not show again too soon; this is never sent anywhere. When a visitor clicks the banner button, a first-party cookie (wise_banner_ref, valid for 7 days) records the banner and the click time so that a resulting WooCommerce order can be attributed to the banner; the cookie is removed once an order is attributed.
